action.description:
If action is specified, a call is made to a function with the specified name and the following signature defined on the src type

   function(Obj obj, TSEvalSpec spec, SimpleMetric metric) : Timeseries

Recommended to used only during prototyping. No incremental invalidation will happen!!!

include.description: Specify the include spec on the source type that you care about when the srcObj is propagated to the action

title: Type for defining action based metrics
name: ActionMetricDecl
